Sec 01: Executive Overview & GCC Compliance Framework

01 Executive Overview & GCC Compliance Framework

1.1 Strategic Solution Purpose

The Gulf Enterprise HR & Payroll Solution is a mission-critical Human Resource Management, Workforce Attendance, and Payroll Processing platform engineered specifically for corporate enterprises, contracting companies, retail groups, and service organizations operating in the Kingdom of Bahrain and the greater Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

1.2 Kingdom of Bahrain Statutory Labor Law Compliance (Law No. 36 of 2012)

GOSI Social Insurance
Bahraini / GCC Citizens: 7.00% Employee Share and 12.00% Employer Share on Basic + Housing.
Expatriate Workforce: 1.00% Employee Share and 3.00% Employer Share on Basic Salary.
LMRA Expatriate Levy
Automated accounting for the monthly 10.000 BHD Labour Market Regulatory Authority (LMRA) work permit levy per expatriate staff member.
Overtime Multipliers (Art. 54)
Normal Day OT: 1.25x hourly wage.
Night (19:00 - 07:00) / Weekend OT: 1.50x.
Official Holiday OT: 2.00x hourly wage.

1.4 Currency, Precision & Regional Timezone Standards

In Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman, currencies are denominated in 1,000 fils/baisa units requiring exact 3-decimal precision (e.g., BD 1,250.750). The system guarantees zero rounding discrepancies across basic salaries, variable allowances, hourly overtime fractions, loan EMI deductions, and net payouts. System timestamps and attendance clocks strictly utilize Asia/Bahrain (GMT+3) timezone synchronization.

Sec 02: System Architecture & Technical Specifications

02 System Architecture & Technical Stack

2.1 Pure Core PHP MVC Architecture (Zero-Bloat Foundation)

Unlike conventional bloated enterprise suites that bundle thousands of unnecessary vendor dependencies and suffer from slow execution, this system is engineered with a custom, ultra-lightweight Pure MVC Core PHP backend:

  • Zero Heavy Framework Dependencies: Built with native PHP 8.x eliminating bulky vendor folders, security vulnerabilities in unvetted third-party packages, and memory overhead.
  • Sub-50ms Response Latency: Clean, compiled routing table and direct PDO singleton connection ensure lightning-fast API responses even under concurrent multi-user load.
  • Stateless RESTful JSON Design: Clean separation between backend services and client interfaces. Every endpoint operates as a pure REST API supporting Authorization: Bearer <token> headers.

2.2 React 19 + Vite Modern Frontend

The user experience is delivered through a high-performance Single Page Application (SPA) built with React 19 and bundled via Vite:

  • Executive Gulf Theme: Premium corporate aesthetic featuring an Indigo & Slate background with vibrant Blue & Pink accenting, glassmorphic cards, and high-readability typography.
  • Horizontal Top Navigation: Optimized for wide executive desktop displays and workstations, keeping all 10 core modules accessible in a single top bar.
  • Native Laser Print Engines: Embedded CSS print drivers specifically formatted for A5 Laser Payslips and 1-31 Landscape Attendance Matrix sheets without third-party PDF pop-ups.

2.3 Relational Database Schema (18 Normalized MySQL Tables)

Core Workforce Tables
usersAdmin, HR, and ESS login credentials with Bcrypt hashes.

employeesComprehensive 360° master employee records (CPR, passport, etc.).

Attendance, Shift & Payroll Tables

2.4 Phase 2 Native Mobile Application Readiness

Because all backend endpoints adhere strictly to stateless RESTful JSON conventions with token-based authentication, the system is architected for immediate Phase 2 plug-and-play connectivity with React Native (iOS & Android) mobile applications for Employee Self-Service (ESS), mobile check-in, leave submissions, and digital payslip viewing without requiring any backend modifications.

3.3 Authentication & Session Security Standards

Passwords are encrypted using Bcrypt (PHP password_hash with cost factor 12). All API communications require a signed Bearer Token transmitted in the HTTP Authorization header. Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) is strictly regulated, SQL injection is completely prevented through parameterized PDO prepared statements, and all HTML inputs are scrubbed against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

Sec 06: Bahrain Smart Card (CPR) Hardware Bridge

06 Bahrain Smart Card (CPR) Hardware Bridge

6.1 SaNDSLabCardBridge Architecture & Technology Stack

One of the crowning technical innovations of the platform is the native Bahrain CPR Smart Card Reader Integration. Built as a specialized .NET bridge application (SaNDSLabCardBridge), it establishes a direct hardware communication pipeline between standard PC/SC smart card readers (e.g., OMNIKEY, Identiv, ACS) and the HR web application:

Bridge Technical Core
  • Runtime: C# .NET 8 / Framework 4.8 high-speed local daemon.
  • PC/SC Driver Layer: Native pcsc-sharp.dll interfacing with Windows WinSCard subsystem.
  • Official IGA/CIO Assemblies: BH.CIO.Smartcard.Bahrain.dll, BH.CIO.Smartcard.IDCardManager.dll, BH.CIO.Smartcard.Lookup.dll.
  • Photo Rendering: Magick.NET decoding embedded biometric citizen photo byte streams into web-ready Base64 PNG formats.
  • Local REST Service: Embedded HTTP server listening on http://127.0.0.1:5050.
Dual CPR Card Generation Compatibility

The Kingdom of Bahrain issued updated smart card designs. SaNDSLabCardBridge dynamically detects the card generation:

  • 2025/2026 New CPR Cards (Back Chip): Reads modern secure memory structures on the rear of the card.
  • Legacy CPR Cards (Front Chip): Backward compatible with earlier contact chip structures.

6.2 Automated One-Click Onboarding Workflow

1
Insert Bahrain Smart Card into USB Reader
The officer inserts the employee's physical CPR card into any connected USB smart card reader. The reader LED indicates active contact.
2
Click "Read Card" in HR Solution Onboarding Modal
The React frontend sends an asynchronous HTTP GET request to http://127.0.0.1:5050/api/operation/ReadCard.
3
Decryption & Attribute Parsing via SaNDSLabCardBridge
The bridge queries the card chip, parses BER-TLV elementary files (EF), maps lookup tables, and decompresses the card photograph.
4
Automatic Form Population (15+ Fields Filled in 1.2 Seconds)
The onboarding form instantly populates CPR Number, Full English Name, Full Arabic Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Nationality, Passport Number, Passport Expiry, Card Expiry, Local Address, and attaches the official digital photo.

6.3 Bridge Launcher Script & Conflict Resolution

The launcher script (Start_Bahrain_Card_Bridge.bat) automatically stops conflicting legacy services (SCardReadServer), configures Windows URL ACL permissions on Port 5050, and starts the bridge with diagnostics.

07 Shift Management & Multi-Shift Rostering

7.1 Shift Master Configuration Parameters

Enterprises operate diverse operational shifts across corporate, retail, security, and industrial divisions. The Shift Master module allows administrators to define custom shift rules:

Shift Code Shift Name Timing Range Standard Hrs Grace Period Night OT Premium
MS01Morning / General Shift08:00 AM – 04:00 PM8.00 Hours15 mins in / 15 mins outNo (Standard Rate 1.25x)

7.2 Shift Rostering & Rest Day Scheduling

Shifts can be assigned through a multi-tier hierarchy:

Shift Assignment Hierarchy
  • Department Default Shift: Default operational shift applied to all employees in a department (e.g. Administration -> Morning Shift).
  • Employee Default Shift: Overrides department default for specific staff (e.g. Night Security Guard -> Night Shift).
  • Roster Override: Day-specific assignments from the monthly shift calendar overriding default rules.
Rest Day & Off-Day Detection

The monthly roster allows managers to assign scheduled rest days (is_off_day = 1):

  • When an employee punches in on an assigned off-day, work is automatically flagged as Rest Day Work.
  • Automatically applies 1.50x Weekend/Rest Day Overtime Multiplier under Bahrain Labor Law.

7.3 Night Shift Differential Accounting (Article 54)

Bahrain Labor Law mandates enhanced compensation for nighttime work. When a shift is designated with is_night_shift = 1, or when hours fall between 19:00 (7:00 PM) and 07:00 (7:00 AM), the overtime calculation engine automatically calculates the 1.50x night premium differential.

Sec 08: Biometric Attendance & Overtime Engine

08 Biometric Attendance & Overtime Engine

8.1 Multi-Channel Attendance Ingestion

Workforce attendance is captured through three flexible operational channels:

  • Universal Biometric CSV / Excel Punch Importer: Ingest punch logs exported from ZKTeco, Suprema, Hikvision, or Anviz biometric devices via drag-and-drop CSV or copy-paste text parser (EmpCode, Date, CheckIn, CheckOut, Status, OvertimeHours).
  • Live Web Check-In / Punch Register: Real-time digital clock marking daily check-in and check-out with automatic late-in tolerance tracking.
  • Manual Attendance Register: Supervisor override grid for duty exemptions, outdoor duty, or off-site project work.

8.2 Bahrain Statutory Overtime Engine (Law No. 36/2012, Article 54)

The overtime engine automatically evaluates daily attendance logs against the employee's assigned shift and statutory thresholds:

STATUTORY HOURLY WAGE FORMULA (BAHRAIN LABOR LAW)
Hourly Wage = (Basic Salary + Fixed Allowances) / (30 Days * 8.0 Standard Hours)
Overtime Classification Statutory Rate Trigger Condition Accounting Application
Normal Working Day Overtime 1.25x (125%) Work hours exceeding 8.0 standard shift hours on normal business days. OT Pay = Excess Hours * Hourly Wage * 1.25
Night Overtime Premium 1.50x (150%) Hours worked during nighttime between 19:00 (7:00 PM) and 07:00 (7:00 AM). Night OT Pay = Night Hours * Hourly Wage * 1.50
Weekend / Rest Day Overtime 1.50x (150%) Any work performed on scheduled weekly rest days (Friday / Saturday / Off Day). Rest Day Pay = Worked Hours * Hourly Wage * 1.50
Official Public Holiday Overtime 2.00x (200%) Work performed on gazetted Bahrain national/religious holidays. Holiday Pay = Worked Hours * Hourly Wage * 2.00

8.3 Grace Periods & Half-Day Automation

Configurable late grace tolerance (e.g. 15 minutes) prevents penalizing employees for minor traffic delays. If worked hours fall between 4.0 and 7.0 hours, the day is automatically classified as Half Day (HD), ensuring fair wage adjustments.

Daily Attendance Status Legend
PPresent: Full day attendance completed within shift hours.

Sec 10: Gulf Payroll Engine & Statutory Deductions

10 Gulf Payroll Engine & Statutory Deductions

10.1 Batch Payroll Processing Pipeline

The payroll engine processes monthly disbursements through a secure, high-speed automated pipeline. HR administrators select the target Pay Period (Month and Year), and can calculate payroll for All Staff, By Department, or for an Individual Employee in a single click:

CORE NET SALARY CALCULATION FORMULA
Net Salary = (Basic Salary + Fixed Allowances + OT Earnings + Bonus) - (GOSI Employee Share + Loan EMI + Absent Deductions)

10.2 Social Insurance (GOSI) Statutory Calculations

Workforce Category Employee Deduction (%) Employer Contribution (%) Salary Calculation Base
Bahraini / GCC Citizens 🇧🇭 7.00% 12.00% Basic Salary + Housing Allowance (HR)
Expatriate Workforce 🌍 1.00% 3.00% Basic Salary Only

10.3 LMRA Levy, Loan Deductions & Absence Proration

  • LMRA Monthly Expatriate Levy: Fixed 10.000 BHD monthly employer levy tracked per active expatriate staff member.
  • Automated Loan EMI Deductions: Active employee loans automatically inject monthly installment deductions, updating outstanding loan ledgers.
  • Statutory Absence Proration: Absence Deduction = (Basic Salary / 30 Days) * Absent Days.
  • Wage Protection System (WPS) Readiness: Generates official SIF (Salary Information File) structures compliant with Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) payroll file formats.

10.4 Recalculation & Pay Period Finalization

Draft payroll runs can be recalculated multiple times to account for retroactive overtime adjustments or approved leaves before final approval and payslip generation.

Sec 11: Official A5 Laser Payslip Generation

11 Official A5 Laser Payslip Generation

11.1 Industry Standard A5 Laser & Thermal Formatting

In Bahrain and the GCC, the standard medium for confidential salary disbursement is the A5 Landscape / Portrait Laser Slip. The system includes an executive laser-optimized payslip generator designed to print two complete payslips per A4 sheet or output directly to dedicated A5 laser/thermal printers:

Dual-Column Financial Breakdown

Clean separation between contractual earnings and statutory deductions:

  • Earnings Column: Basic Salary, Housing Allowance, Transport, Car, Mobile, Food, Overtime Pay, Bonus, Incentives.
  • Deductions Column: Employee GOSI (7% / 1%), Active Loan EMI, Unpaid Absence Deductions.
  • Net Payout: Clear display in figures (BD 1,250.000) and full alphabetical word representation.
Dual Authorization Signature Blocks

Each generated payslip features two official acknowledgment boxes:

  • Prepared & Verified By: HR & Accounts Officer seal and authorization signature.
  • Employee Acknowledgment: Formal signature line confirming receipt of net salary without dispute.
  • WPS Compliant: Includes Bank Name and IBAN for seamless Wage Protection System auditing.

11.2 Single-Click Bulk Printing & Employee Self-Service Delivery

Administrators can batch print all payslips for an entire department or company with a single click. Simultaneously, individual payslips are instantly published to the Employee Self-Service (ESS) portal, where staff members can view and download encrypted PDF copies securely.

11.3 Security & Anti-Tampering Features

Each payslip contains a cryptographic transaction hash, document generation timestamp, and unique payslip ID matching the internal database record, preventing salary certificate forgery.

Sec 12: Indemnity (EOSB) & Final Settlement Engine

12 Indemnity (EOSB) & Final Settlement Engine

12.1 Statutory Bahrain Gratuity Formula (Law No. 36/2012, Article 116)

When an employee concludes their service, the system calculates End of Service Benefits (Indemnity) based on exact continuous service duration:

Tier 1: First 3 Years of Service
15 Days Basic Salary for each year of continuous service during the first 3 years.
Yearly Rate = Basic Salary * (15 / 30) = 0.5 * Basic Salary
Tier 2: Beyond 3 Years of Service
30 Days (1 Full Month) Basic Salary for each subsequent year of service.
Yearly Rate = Basic Salary * (30 / 30) = 1.0 * Basic Salary
PRO-RATA FRACTIONAL SERVICE INDEMNITY FORMULA
Total Indemnity = (Min(Years, 3.0) * 0.5 * Basic) + (Max(0, Years - 3.0) * 1.0 * Basic) + Pro-Rata Days Calculation

12.2 Resignation vs Termination Multipliers & Leave Encashment

  • Termination by Employer / Non-Renewal: 100% full statutory indemnity entitlement.
  • Voluntary Resignation: Scaled according to Article 116 service brackets (< 3 yrs = 0%, 3-5 yrs = partial, > 5 yrs = 100%).
  • Unused Annual Leave Encashment: Leave Salary = (Basic Salary / 30 Days) * Unused Annual Leave Days.
  • Final Settlement Certificate: Official legal clearance statement consolidating Indemnity, Leave Salary, Notice Pay, Loan balances, and Net Final Settlement with full employee discharge waiver.

12.3 Legal Discharge & Ministry of Labour Compliance

The generated Final Settlement Certificate contains standard bilingual legal release clauses confirming the employee has received all statutory dues and releases the employer from further civil or labor claims.

The leave management engine administers statutory leave entitlements with multi-tier approval workflows:

Leave Category Statutory Allocation Remuneration Policy Labor Law Reference

13.2 Multi-Stage Approval Lifecycle

Approval Stages
  • Step 1: Submission: Employee requests leave via portal with dates, reason, handover notes, and replacement contact.

  • Tiered sick leaves past day 15 trigger 50% basic salary deductions.

Sec 14: Loans, Advances & EMI Schedules

14 Employee Loans, Advances & EMI Schedules

14.1 Loan Origination & EMI Scheduling

To assist workforce welfare while maintaining disciplined corporate accounting, HR administrators can record employee emergency loans, vehicle loans, and salary advances:

Loan Origination Parameters
  • Principal Amount: Disbursed loan sum in local currency (e.g. BD 600.000).
  • Tenure (Months): Repayment window (e.g. 6, 12, 24 months).
  • Start Period: Month and year when first EMI deduction begins.
  • Reason / Category: Emergency medical, education, family travel, housing advance.
Automated Monthly EMI Calculation
EQUATED MONTHLY INSTALLMENT
Monthly EMI = Principal Amount / Tenure Months

Fractional decimals are handled cleanly to ensure zero rounding slippage across the repayment lifespan.

14.2 Integrated Payroll Deduction & Balance Depletion

During each monthly payroll batch run, the payroll engine automatically queries active loans:

  • The monthly EMI is deducted directly from gross earnings as a statutory/voluntary deduction.
  • The deduction is logged into loan_repayments with the pay period reference.
  • The outstanding loan balance decreases in real-time. Once the balance reaches 0.000, the loan automatically flips to Fully Paid.

14.3 Early Settlement & Exit Deductions

Employees can make lump-sum early repayments. In the event of contract termination or resignation, any remaining loan balance is automatically pulled into the Final Settlement Engine to offset against accrued EOSB Indemnity before net payout.
